about: SCION 31 Alpha Matting: what the dog did, measured from its own render. x_screen/y_screen = alpha-weighted centroid of the dog matte as composited; dog_left..dog_bottom = its solid (alpha>0.5) extent on screen; facing +1 = toward the door (screen left), -1 = back turned; state is read from the pose the render chose.
mapping: x_screen = 330 + 190 * x_score (camera static); while lying facing the door the matte is set 48 px further in
